title: SE implementation scratchpad - Atlas Trust
content:
Quick running notes for Atlas Trust implementation -- personal scratchpad. Mostly action items and config reminders. Not polished.

2024-10-05 - kickoff notes
- Intro call notes: Atlas Trust (prod: atlas-trust-prod) wants private deployment in AWS GovCloud (us-gov-west-1) with HSM-backed key management. Primary use: customer support summarization + internal doc search (embeddings).
- Initial capacity ask: 100 concurrent users, peak qps ~ 40 requests/s, typical prompt length ~ 600 tokens. Team recommended Dedicated w/ burst buffer but legal asked Private VPC.
- Risk flags: SOC2 + FedRAMP considerations, need audit logs, retention + data residency.

High-level plan
- Deliver private deployment (customer-managed VPC) using Redwood Private control plane.
- Provide dedicated inference pool (reserved GPU) in their GovCloud account, integrate KMS/HSM via customer AWS KMS with external key policy.
- Model pinning to redwood/redwood-2b or an equivalent open model (team to confirm model family).

Action items (personal)
- [ ] Create draft SOW skeleton and send to legal (due 2024-10-11) -- include deployment topology, support hours, SLAs
- [x] Confirm region: us-gov-west-1 (confirmed 10/05)
- [ ] Setup architecture diagram for security review (include flow for logs -> CloudWatch -> SIEM)
- [ ] Draft KMS integration notes and sample IAM policy for Atlas Trust security team
- [ ] Prepare perf/cost estimate for 100 concurrent users (need input from infra on batch sizing)
- [ ] Schedule tech deep-dive w/ Atlas infra (target 2024-10-09) -- pending calendar invite
- [ ] Create initial infra terraform template for private deployment (baseline)

Config notes / reminders
- VPC peering vs Transit Gateway: customer prefers TGW. Confirm if TGW is compatible with Private control plane (check infra team doc).
- Subnet requirements: need private subnets in at least 2 AZs, NAT gateway for control-plane egress (if required), dedicated ENIs for GPU nodes.
- Security groups: allow outbound to Redwood control-plane endpoints (TBD), but restrict inbound to management CIDRs only.
- KMS: Atlas requires HSM-backed CMKs. Need policy that allows Redwood service principal to use key (customer to set). Provide example policy: "{\"Effect\": \"Allow\",\"Principal\": { \"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::REPLACE_WITH_REDWOOD_ROLE\" },\"Action\": [\"kms:Encrypt\",\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"],\"Resource\": \"*\"
}" (send as sample, security will adjust)
- Audit logs: enable S3 bucket + CloudTrail in GovCloud; retention 7 years per compliance ask. Need lifecycle policy.

Model + runtime notes
- Suggested initial model: redwood-2b (low cost) for retrieval-augmented generation + embeddings: text-embedding-3-small (or open equivalent).
- Pin models for rollout: production -> redwood-2b:v1, fallback -> redwood-2b:v1-quant (lower mem). Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on latency > 750ms or error rate > 2%.
- Batching: default batch_timeout 10ms, max_batch_size 64 for GPU type a100x. Ask infra for recommended batch settings for GovCloud instance types.

Notes from 2024-10-07 follow-up
- Customer provided network diagram (received). They use TGW + centralized logging. They asked whether we can restrict egress to only Redwood control plane; infra says possible via NAT + endpoint filters.
- Legal asked for data deletion process: must be able to purge customer data on request and provide attestations. Need runbook.

Open questions / TODO for infra/security
- Can Redwood Private control plane operate with customer's TGW + strict VPC endpoints? (ask infra-eng)
- Which AWS instance families are available in us-gov-west-1 for GPU (a100, h100 availability?)
- Confirm support for HSM-backed KMS in GovCloud (HSM CMAK) and sample IAM role ARN for Redwood-managed components.
- Is there a max token limit per request we should enforce in config (customer expects max 4096 tokens)?

Meeting prep for 2024-10-09 tech deep-dive
- Agenda: topology, KMS/HSM integration, logging and retention, network egress rules, model choices, SLOs and rollback policy.
- Bring: sample terraform skeleton, sample KMS policy, perf/cost rough calc (per infra), canary rollout doc excerpt.
- Ask Atlas: expected RPS distribution, typical prompt shapes, any PII in prompts, regulatory audit cadence.

Notes to self (shortcuts and references)
- Confluence onboarding page: confluence://atlas-trust-onboarding
- Jira epic: JIRA-AT-78 (implementation) -> link these when drafting SOW
- PR template for se-configs: github.com/redwood-inference/se-configs/pull/56

Random quick logs (scratch)
- 10:05AM: Sent initial email to Atlas security with sample KMS policy.
- 2:30PM: Spoke to Ethan re: batch sizing; he suggested testing with max_batch_size 48 for initial run.

End of scratchpad.

(Will tidy into a proper runbook once infra answers the TGW/KMS availability questions.)
